title: Non-atomic shared counter in settings tests races under odin test's concurrent @(test) threads
evidence:
settings_test_seq: u64 // package counter — unique within the test binary

tmp_settings_path :: proc(t: ^testing.T) -> string {
	settings_test_seq += 1
--- gate line ---
"Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && odin test app -out:bin/app-test && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
detail: odin test runs @(test) procs concurrently on threads. Eight settings tests do the unguarded read-modify-write settings_test_seq += 1; two can draw the same seq, share one temp path, and clobber/remove each other's fixtures — flaky gate 2.
recommended_fix: Derive the temp path from the test name (t.name) or make the counter atomic (core:sync/atomic); alternatively force these tests sequential via testing.set_parallel(false).

title: palcheck map-pair threshold selected by color VALUE equality, not pair identity — diverges from the derivation twin
detail: If a future mode-table edit sets any signal token's color equal to water/park/coast/canvas, that signal pair silently gets the weaker 40 threshold while the Python twin still enforces 48 — the oracle and derivation disagree.
recommended_fix: Key the threshold by pair identity (the four map pairs are a known suffix of the pairs list), not by comparing pr[0] against the current map token colors.

title: modal_blocks_world check asserts panel closed but never the 'selection intact' state its comment claims
detail: Only panel_open is checked. A regression mapping the suppressed X to a selection-clearing no-command path (e.g. Cancel) keeps the log empty and passes — the stated selection-intact leg is unverified.
recommended_fix: Add runs[i].sel_pipe == 0 (mouse/touch legs select pipe 0 before opening) to the modal_blocks_world assertion so the selection-survives claim is pinned.
